task.subject: The dependency update planner standalone workflow in githubnext/gh-cao and its retained deterministic configuration smells and native hardening attainment
task.intent: Show whether the dependency update planner's compiled configuration still carries high-severity fail-open or supply-chain defects, what remediation each defect needs, and how its native workflow-hardening attainment evolves, so an operator can correct the configuration before the next compile.
activationConditions: The githubnext/gh-cao repository declares a standalone workflow at .github/workflows/dependency-update-planner.md.
The deterministic workflow-smells inspection evaluates the compiled metadata of that workflow within the 30-day horizon.
The gh-aw operational-value protocol publishes workflow-hardening-attainment observations for that workflow.
requiredEffects: Each retained high-severity workflow-smells observation for the workflow appears in the remediation queue with its smell name, category, summary, evidence, recommendation, observation time, and a link to the workflow.
Each published workflow-hardening-attainment observation appears once per observed day with its native value and maturity status, so interim and matured values remain distinguishable.
The high-severity smell count is a count of retained smell observations and is not presented as a run count, a failure count, or the attainment metric.
noopConditions: No high-severity smell is retained for the workflow in the horizon; the empty queue is not proof that an inspection ran or that the configuration is complete.
No workflow-hardening-attainment observation is published for the workflow in the horizon; the trend has no points and must not be filled with zeros.
The workflow-smells or operational-values source is unavailable; the dashboard must report an unavailable state rather than an empty or zero result.
successConditions: The operator can identify each remaining high-severity defect and its recommended remediation without opening a workflow run.
Missing or incomplete attainment observations remain null gaps and never appear as zero attainment.
The remediation queue is ordered deterministically by observation time descending and then by smell identity ascending.
uncertainties: A workflow smell is deterministic configuration evidence; it does not establish that the workflow was exploited or that a remediation was merged.
A smell disappears from the queue only after a later complete inspection; absence alone does not prove remediation.
Workflow-hardening attainment is gh-aw's native result and is maturity-dependent; an interim value is not final attainment.

operationalValue.preservation: Preserve the upstream metric identity, order, native finite value or null, ratio unit, higher-is-better direction, and maturity status. The high-severity smell count is a separate deterministic count and must never replace or be combined with the attainment metric.

contract.opportunity: One stable design-time opportunity per workflow path and compiled workflow revision in githubnext/gh-cao; every hypothetical inspection run is bound to that opportunity.
acceptedEvidence: workflow-smells observations for the same organization, repository, and workflow path at the bound compiled revision.
A complete gh-aw operational-value inspection of the same bound revision, identified by its workflow-hardening-attainment observation.

metric.intent: Native gh-aw ratio of hardening checks satisfied to hardening checks evaluated for the bound revision. The dashboard consumes the published value and never recomputes it.

contract.maturation: An observation is mature only after gh-aw publishes a complete inspection of the bound revision. Interim observations stay distinct and are not final attainment.
contract.zeroRule: Zero is valid only when a complete inspection evaluated at least one hardening check and every evaluated check failed. No smell row, missing inspection, partial inspection, or unavailable source is zero.
contract.missingEvidenceRule: A missing, partial, or unavailable inspection, or one that evaluated zero checks, yields a null value with a missing reason. Null is never converted to zero and is never inferred from workflow run success.

rows.smell-summary: A container image is referenced by a mutable tag instead of an immutable digest.
rows.smell-evidence: Compiled manifest references node:22-alpine by tag only.
rows.smell-recommendation: Pin the container image to its immutable digest and recompile the workflow.
